SELECT 
    *

WHERE "pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL 
  AND "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL 
  AND "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN "pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'stores' 
        WHEN "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'sales'
        WHEN "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'products'
        ELSE 'none'
    END as data_type,
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM store_region_product_category_sales
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH sales_with_region AS (
    SELECT 
        s.transaction_id,
        s.store_id,
        st.region,
        s.category,
        s.total_amount
    FROM 'C:\Users\amarkkumar\Downloads\Amar_usecase\amar_case\data\landing\sales_data 1 4.csv' s
    JOIN 'C:\Users\amarkkumar\Downloads\Amar_usecase\amar_case\data\landing\stores 1 4.csv' st
        ON s.store_id = st.store_id
),
category_regional_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        category,
        SUM(total_amount) as total_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) as transaction_count
    FROM sales_with_region
    GROUP BY region, category
),
regional_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        SUM(total_revenue) as region_total_revenue
    FROM category_regional_revenue
    GROUP BY region
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        crr.region,
        crr.category,
        crr.total_revenue,
        crr.transaction_count,
        rt.region_total_revenue,
        ROUND((crr.total_revenue / rt.region_total_revenue) * 100, 2) as pct_of_regional_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY crr.region ORDER BY crr.total_revenue DESC) as revenue_rank
    FROM category_regional_revenue crr
    JOIN regional_totals rt ON crr.region = rt.region
)
SELECT 
    region,
    category,
    ROUND(total_revenue, 2) as total_revenue,
    transaction_count,
    ROUND(region_total_revenue, 2) as region_total_revenue,
    pct_of_regional_revenue,
    revenue_rank,
    CASE WHEN revenue_rank = 1 THEN 'TOP PERFORMER' ELSE '' END as top_performer_flag
FROM ranked_categories
ORDER BY region, revenue_rank
